verdict.rationale: Postman supports contract validation via test scripts that assert on live responses (status codes, schema/body checks), API governance rule checks against specs, and CI/CD integration via Postman CLI to fail builds on drift; Application Inventory can also cross-check API calls against collections. However, there's no first-party evidence of a dedicated automated contract-diff/drift-detection feature comparing live traffic against an OpenAPI/collection contract continuously. missing for 10: dedicated drift-detection/contract-diff tooling with alerting, independent/hands-on evidence of catching real contract drift in production.
